topic: Buying a Used Car from a Lot

script.title: THE USED CAR LOT
script.scene_zh: 二手車行 · 試車議價
script.story_hook: One silver SUV, one careful buyer, one honest salesperson.
script.intro_zh: 一台銀色休旅車，一位細心的買主，一位誠實的車行人員。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to today's used-car lot. Listen for great buying phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到今天的二手車場。留意買車實用說法。
script.outro: A test drive, a deal, and a Saturday plan. Listen once more and repeat.
script.outro_zh: 試車、談價，約好週六再見。再聽一遍，跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now, let's say each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: He's Cheap and Very Suspicious of Everyone
script.char_a_description: a friendly guy in his thirties with short brown hair, a light beard, a navy denim jacket over a heather grey hoodie, dark jeans, clean white sneakers, and a broad-shouldered build
script.char_b_description: a sharp salesperson in her fifties with a chin-length blonde bob, gold hoop earrings, a tailored charcoal blazer with a red dealership name tag, black trousers, low heels, and a poised medium build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm curious about that silver SUV outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm ˈkjʊɹiˌəbs ˈabaʊt ðæt ˈsɪlvɚ ˌesˈjuˈvi ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我對外面那輛銀色休旅車很有興趣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great eye, that one just arrived yesterday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt aɪ ðæt wʌn dʒʌst əˈɹaɪvd ˈjɛstɚˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 您眼光真好，那台昨天才剛到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It looks clean. What's the mileage?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lʊks klin wʌts ðə ˈmaɪlɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 看起來很乾淨。里程數多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty-two thousand, all highway, I believe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti tu ˈθaʊzənd ɔl ˈhaɪˌweɪ aɪ bɪˈliv/
dialogue.zh: 我想應該都是跑高速，六萬二千英里。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, highway miles are the good kind, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈhaɪˌweɪ maɪlz ɑɹ ðə ɡʊd kaɪnd ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，高速里程是最好的那種，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They sure are, city miles chew up cars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ʃʊɹ ɑɹ ˈsɪti ˈmaɪlz tʃu ʌp kɑɹz/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，市區里程最傷車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My old one lived in traffic, poor thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈoʊld wʌn lɪvd ɪn ˈtɹæfɪk pʊr θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我的舊車天天塞車，可憐見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, this one won't have those problems.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðɪs wʌn woʊnt hæv ðoʊz ˈpɹɑbləmz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，這台車就沒有那些煩惱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pop the hood and peek?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən aɪ pɑp ðə hʊd ænd pik/
dialogue.zh: 我可以掀開引擎蓋看一眼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, keys are in my pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs kiz ɑɹ ɪn maɪ ˈpɑkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 當然，鑰匙就在我口袋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, the oil looks... a little dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ði ɔɪl lʊks ə ˈlɪɾəl dɑɹk/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，機油看起來……有點深。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's due for a change this week, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts du fɚ ə tʃeɪndʒ ðɪs wik ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，這週正該換機油了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This week? Isn't that the seller's job?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wik ˈɪzənt ðæt ðə ˈsɛləɹz dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 這週？保養難道不是賣方該先做好的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair, we'll do it free before pickup.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ wil du ɪt fɹi bɪˈfɔɹ ˈpɪkˌʌp/
dialogue.zh: 有道理，交車前我們免費幫您換好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that helps. Can I test drive it?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðæt hɛlps kən aɪ tɛst dɹaɪv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，這點我買單。可以試車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely, do you have your license?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌæbsəˈlutli du ju hæv jɔɹ ˈlaɪsəns/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，請讓我看看您的駕照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right here. Um, how long can I drive?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt hɪɹ ʌm haʊ lɔŋ kən aɪ dɹaɪv/
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡。嗯，我可以開多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen minutes, loop goes past the highway ramp.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪfˈtin ˈmɪnɪts lup ɡoʊz pæst ðə ˈhaɪˌweɪ ræmp/
dialogue.zh: 十五分鐘，路線會繞到高速匝道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I want to feel it at speed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt aɪ wɑnt tə fil ɪt æt spid/
dialogue.zh: 正好，我想感受一下速度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just be gentle, she's still getting to know you.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst bi ˈdʒɛntəl ʃiz stɪl ˈɡɛɾɪŋ tə noʊ ju/
dialogue.zh: 請對她溫柔點，她還在跟你磨合呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, starting her up... listen to that engine.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈstɑɹtɪŋ hɚ ʌp ˈlɪsən tə ðæt ˈɛndʒən/
dialogue.zh: 哈，啟動了……你聽這引擎聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Purrs like it means it, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /pɝz laɪk ɪt minz ɪt ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 引擎運轉得特別認真，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brakes feel firm, the steering's straight too.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹeɪks fil fɝm ðə ˈstɪɹɪŋz stɹeɪt tu/
dialogue.zh: 煞車很紮實，方向也沒有偏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? Easy sale, I was almost nervous.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ˈizi seɪl aɪ wəz ˈɔlmoʊst ˈnɝvəs/
dialogue.zh: 看見沒？我剛剛還有點小緊張呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost? Well, one odd thing back there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst wɛl wʌn ɑd θɪŋ bæk ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 還「幾乎」？嗯，剛剛有點小怪事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh? Like what, um, a noise?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ laɪk wʌt ʌm ə nɔɪz/
dialogue.zh: 噢？例如呢，嗯，是有聲音嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A slight shake around sixty, nothing scary.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə slaɪt ʃeɪk əˈɹaʊnd ˈsɪksti ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈskɛɹi/
dialogue.zh: 時速六十左右有點抖，還不到嚇人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's usually balance weights or a tire.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈjuʒəˌli ˈbæləns weɪts ɔɹ ə ˈtaɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那通常是平衡塊或輪胎的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or a bent rim from a big pothole.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔɹ ə bɛnt ɹɪm fɹəm ə bɪɡ ˈpɑtˌhoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 也可能是大坑洞撞歪了鋁圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also possible, but the tires look pretty new.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ ˈpɑsəbl bʌt ðə ˈtaɪɚz lʊk ˈpɹɪti nju/
dialogue.zh: 也有可能，不過輪胎看起來挺新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True. What's your bottom-line price?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹu wʌts jɔɹ ˈbɑtəmˌlaɪn pɹaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 也是。這台你們最低成交價多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sticker says fourteen thousand, nine hundred.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈstɪkɚ sɛz fɔːrˈtin ˈθaʊzənd naɪn ˈhʌndɹəd/
dialogue.zh: 標示價是一萬四千九百美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, similar ones online run closer to thirteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ˈsɪmələɹ wʌnz ˈɑnˌlaɪn ɹʌn ˈkloʊsɚ tə θɝˈtin/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，網上同款大概都一萬三上下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Online ones never include our ninety-day warranty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnˌlaɪn wʌnz ˈnɛvɚ ɪnˈklud ˈaʊɚ ˈnaɪnti deɪ ˈwɔɹənti/
dialogue.zh: 網上的車可不含我們九十天保固。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That warranty covers the engine and gearbox?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈwɔɹənti ˈkʌvɚz ði ˈɛndʒən ænd ˈɡɛɹbˌɑks/
dialogue.zh: 那個保固涵蓋引擎和變速箱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Engine, transmission, everything under the hood basically.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛndʒən trænzˈmɪʃən ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ ˈʌndɚ ðə hʊd ˈbeɪsɪkli/
dialogue.zh: 引擎、變速箱，基本上引擎蓋底下都算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, what if I pay cash today?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wʌt ɪf aɪ peɪ kæʃ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好，如果我今天現金成交呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I can shave off three hundred.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ kən ʃeɪv ɔf θɹi ˈhʌndɹəd/
dialogue.zh: 那我可以再減三百美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, fourteen thousand, six hundred?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ fɔːrˈtin ˈθaʊzənd sɪks ˈhʌndɹəd/
dialogue.zh: 所以是一萬四千六百美元？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did that fast! Just kidding, no rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dɪd ðæt fæst dʒʌst ˈkɪdɪŋ noʊ ɹʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 您算得真快！開玩笑的，不用急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, I'm not done inspecting her.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn aɪm ɑt dʌn ɪnˈspɛktɪŋ hɚ/
dialogue.zh: 先別急，我還沒檢查完這台車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh! Of course, take your time, no rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʌ ʌv kɔɹs teɪk jɔɹ taɪm noʊ ɹʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 噢！當然，您慢慢看，真不急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's rust here under the door edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹz ɹʌst hɪɹ ˈʌndɚ ðə dɔɹ ɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 車門下緣這裡生鏽了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Surface stuff, we can treat it for free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɝfəs sʌf wi kən tɹit ɪt fɚ fɹi/
dialogue.zh: 只是表面鏽蝕，我們可以免費處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd like my own mechanic to check it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk maɪ ˈoʊn məˈkænɪk tə tʃɛk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我想請我自己的技師再確認一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally fine, we allow pre-purchase inspections.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊɾəli faɪn wi əˈlaʊ pɹi ˈpɝʧəs ˌɪnˈspɛkʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 完全沒問題，我們開放買主自行驗車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, he's cheap and very suspicious of everyone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt hiz tʃip ænd ˈvɛɹi səˈspɪʃəs əv ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，他收費便宜，而且對誰都不放心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sounds like my favorite kind of professional.
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz laɪk maɪ ˈfeɪvɚɪt kaɪnd əv pɹəˈfɛʃənəl/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來正是我最欣賞的那種師傅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you hold it till Saturday morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən ju hoʊld ɪt tɪl ˈsætɚˌdeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我留車到週六早上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll park it inside and put your name on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl pɑɹk ɪt ɪnˈsaɪd ænd pʊt jɔɹ neɪm ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我會把它開進車庫，掛上您的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Awesome. If it passes, I'll take it cash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔsəm ɪf ɪt ˈpæsəz aɪl teɪk ɪt kæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 太棒了。檢查過關，我就現金成交。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And if it doesn't, no hard feelings.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ɪt dʌzənt noʊ hɑɹd ˈfilɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 要是不過關，咱們也別傷和氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly. Oh, one more thing — floor mats?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli oʊ wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ flɔɹ mæts/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣。噢，還有一件事，腳墊呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll get a fresh set, rubber ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /jul ɡɛt ə fɹɛɹ sɛt ˈɹʌbɚ wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 會送您全新的一組，橡膠材質。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the old owner's parking pass, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ði ˈoʊld ˈoʊnɚz ˈpɑɹkɪŋ pæs pliz/
dialogue.zh: 還有前車主的停車證，也一併給我吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, that's gone with the previous owner.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðæts ɡɑn wɪð ðə ˈpɹivɪəs ˈoʊnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，那個跟著前車主一起走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Worth a try. See you Saturday, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɝθ ə tɹaɪ si ju ˈsætɚˌdeɪ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 試一下無妨。那就週六見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you Saturday, bring your suspicious mechanic.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ˈsætɚˌdeɪ bɹɪŋ jɔɹ səˈspɪʃəs məˈkænɪk/
dialogue.zh: 週六見，記得帶上您那位多疑的技師。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do. Thanks for the honest answers today.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du θæŋks fɚ ði ˈɑnɪst ˈænsɚz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 一定。謝謝您今天有問必答。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honesty sells cars, mostly. Have a good one!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəsti sɛlz kɑɹz ˈmoʊstli hæv ə ɡʊd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 誠實最好賣車，大部分時候是啦。祝您好運！

script.youtube_title: 【買二手車不踩雷🚗】「他對誰都不放心😆」試車砍價完整攻略💰｜保固・留車・驗車英文一次學｜60句沉浸聽力｜Buying a Used Car from a Lot
script.youtube_title_en: "He's Cheap and Very Suspicious of Everyone" — Buying a Used Car
script.youtube_description:
「他對誰都不放心」——買二手車時，那位多疑的技師朋友反而最可靠！這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在二手車行的停車場。

你會聽到：詢問里程與車況、開引擎蓋檢查機油；完整試車對話，從時速、煞車到車身抖動的反應；比價、砍價、現金成交與九十天保固的說法；還有請自己信任的技師驗車、請車行留車到週末的禮貌表達。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，充滿美國人真實語感：um、well、so、ha。聽完你就會用：What's the mileage?、Can I test drive it?、What's your bottom-line price?、Can you hold it till Saturday?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴噹。
script.youtube_description_en:
"He's cheap and very suspicious of everyone" — and that is exactly what you want inspecting your next used car! This is a 60-line immersive listening practice at a used-car lot.

You will hear: asking about mileage and highway miles, peeking under the hood at the oil, a full test-drive chat about brakes, steering and a slight shake at speed, comparing prices online, negotiating a cash discount, and asking the lot to hold the car until Saturday for your own mechanic.

Everything stays in A2-level words with natural American fillers: um, well, so, ha. By the end you'll own phrases like What's the mileage?, Can I test drive it?, What's your bottom-line price?, and No hard feelings.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
停車場裡那台銀色休旅車看起來很完美，可是機油有點深、車門下緣有點鏽，到底能不能買？用英文問里程、砍價、留車，該怎麼開口？

這一集帶大家走過一次完整的買二手車流程：看車、開引擎蓋、試車、找出小毛病、談保固與現金價，再到約技師驗車、請車行留車，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🚗 問里程：It looks clean. What's the mileage?
🔑 要試車：Okay, that helps. Can I test drive it?
💰 談價格：Okay, what if I pay cash today?
🔍 約驗車：Great, he's cheap and very suspicious of everyone.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。下次走進任何場景，這些英文都會自己從嘴邊冒出來。

祝你也找到那台讓你安心的好車。
